main_text.p: ventum non feminabit, & qui speculatu[?] nubes non metet, inquit Solomon. Imo[?] vix fieri poteft quin ut multa fane facia[?] viro bono indigna : Prov.29. 25.{1} Timor enim hominis, eodem Salomone tefte, adducit laqueum. At fiquis forte præ animi angustia incautior laqueo fe implicari paffu fuerit, ligavit ligamen fuper animam suam, & tenetur id quod promisit ac[?] implere.
main_text.head: SECT. XV.
main_text.p: Casus 3°Casus Secundus est, ubi gravis i[?] justus est metus, & qui cadere poteft i[?] constantem virum : qualis est metus c[?] ptivitatis, amissionis omnium bonorum infamiæ, cruciatus, & quod est ἡ φοβερὰ[?] φοβερώτατον ipsius mortis. Dico primum ut supra, si juramentum contineat in quid illiciti, ne vel mortis vitandæ causa à viro honesto suscipi debere ; ne suceptum posse fine peccato servari. Audite Christiani auream hominis Eth[?]nici hac de re sententiam : {m}juftum tenacem propositi virum Non civium ardor prava jubentium, Non vultus instantis tyranni Mente quatit solida. Dic[?] secundo, si res exigatur intentata vi a[?]

page.notes: Right edge of the scan cuts off the right ends of most lines; those words are partly lost and marked [?]. The hyphens at the line ends (ho-minis, la-queum, angu-stia, Eth-nici) are cut off and not certainly visible. The Greek words in the line "ἡ φοβερὰ φοβερώτατον" are doubtful. The reference mark for the Horat. note (left margin) is not visible in the text; it is given as m. The note "Prov.29. 25." stands beside "viro bono" with its mark 1. The catchword is only partly visible.
